results.change_intent: Add test cases ensuring Type::fromValue produces enum types for both pure and backed enum values.
results.summary: Well-targeted test cases covering both pure and backed enums.

results.change_intent: Identify enum objects in Type::fromValue and map them to enum types instead of generic object types.
results.summary: Fixes enum detection in Type::fromValue, though the check can be simplified using the instanceof operator.

issues.comment: The check `\is_object($value) && is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class)` can be replaced with `$value instanceof \UnitEnum`. `instanceof` safely handles non-objects and avoids the overhead of inspecting the class string via `is_subclass_of`. Calling `self::enum(...)` is also more consistent with surrounding branches like `self::object()`.
issues.suggestion: Replace `\is_object($value) && is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class) => Type::enum($value::class),` with `$value instanceof \UnitEnum => self::enum($value::class),`.
